description: We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This is an exceptional opportunity to make a significant impact on patient care and facility success.The ideal candidate will be a visionary leader with a passion for delivering high-quality healthcare services. You will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of facility management, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards, and fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff. Join a dedicated team committed to excellence and community well-being.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as an LNHA in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility.
Demonstrated leadership abilities and a track record of operational excellence.
Thorough knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care.
Strong financial management and communication skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation based on experience, ranging from $115,000 to $145,000 annually.
